_comment: Sources and treatment for the PREVIEW photographs. Run scripts/images/build-preview-photos.py. Entries with a 'download' are openly licensed stock photographs; entries with 'supplied': true are images supplied for review whose origin and rights are not yet confirmed. Every one is shown only as a labelled preview, and none is approved Alder & Ember product or project photography unless it carries an 'approval' record.
